run_CppGenerator: run the CppGenerator script to generate C++ glue code from an EXPRESS schema file
run_work_function: run the work function to parse a schema file and generate StepReaderGen header and source files
generate_fields: generate C++ struct field declarations for an EXPRESS entity using the schema type mappings
generate_converter: generate a GenericFill converter function for an EXPRESS entity with argument validation and field conversion
sort_entity_list: sort the schema entity list by resolving inheritance dependencies so base classes appear before derived classes
